name: Kihō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kihō town emblem in green: a green ring of stylised figures around a leaf-like device.
history: Municipal flag of Kihō, a town in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 January 2006.

features.role: Kihō town emblem — a green ring of stylised figures around a leaf-like device
